title: Last opened sessions are not re-opened on next startup
author: meyergru
body_snippet:
**What happens** (and what you expected instead):

I switched from a beta to the most current version 1.83.0 Release 3661 and found that the open connections from the last start are not carried over to a re-invocation as I was used to before.

Instead, mRemoteNG always starts with no open tabs.

**Steps to reproduce:**

1. Open a few connections
2. Close the program
3. Start the program again - no open tabs.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
This is by design, though the change of behavior between your beta and 1.83.0 is real and deserves the explanation.

Reopening the previous session's tabs is controlled by **File → Options → Startup/Exit → "Reconnect to previously opened sessions on startup"**, and that option is **off by default**. Some earlier nightlies had a bug (#120) where the saved panel layout reopened its connection tabs *regardless* of that setting — every previously open session reconnected on startup even when the use...

comments.author: meyergru
comments.snippet:
I had tried that, but forgot to apply the settings, so it did not get honored - however:

When I open two tabs (say A and B), close the program and re-open it, the tabs are duplicated (A,B,A,B).

What is interesting, when I close all of those four tabs and restart, I get only A an B.  When I close that again without changing anything, next time I get A,B,A,B again. However - it does not add two windows each time, it stays at 4.

The same duplication also occurs with three open tabs - those will ...

comments.author: meyergru
comments.snippet:
On a side note: 1.82 Beta had this setting, too. It opened the last open tabs even when it was disabled. Interestingly enough, when I downgraded and left the setting on, the behaviour was exactly like with the current 1.83 release.

That is:

1.82 Beta opens tabs duplicated when the setting is on - opens the correct tabs when it is off.
1.83 opens tabs duplicated when the setting is on - opens no tabs when it is off.

comments.author: meyergru
comments.snippet: I tested Nightly Build — 20260903 (v1.83.0). It does not reopen the last tabs at all now.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
You were right, and the fix we shipped made it worse — thank you for testing it the same day and saying so plainly.

The previous change made the saved dock layout the owner of reopening, and had the tree path skip every connection the layout *named*. The hole you found immediately: if the layout named a connection and then did not actually open it, both paths stood aside and the tab was simply lost. That is why you got nothing at all instead of duplicates.

comments.snippet: Thank you for testing all three rounds — including the one that made it worse, and saying so plainly the same day. That is what turned a "works as designed" answer into a real fix. Closed as you left it.

comments.author: meyergru
comments.snippet:
I have to reopen this issue again. With 1.84, the behavior is now that the open connections are not saved per default.

That is, if I forget to actually save the connections, the old configuration is reused.

Before, closing mRemoteNG persisted the open connections that were active when closed.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for coming back to this and describing it so exactly: "if I forget to save, the old configuration is reused" pointed straight at the cause.

You are right, and it is a regression in 1.84.0. Two things reopen the previous session. The saved panel layout records the tabs that are open when you close mRemoteNG, every time.
